title: Prove exact joint Gaussian transition cost with dirty workspace (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with exact finite corroboration; no new kappa. Joint execution cannot reduce the sum of the standalone transition charges for the Gaussian-dyadic blocks `2^a (1+epsilon*i)^b`, with integer a, b in {0,1}, and epsilon in {-1,1}, even with arbitrary cross-helper mixing and restored arbitrary dirty workspace.

```text
minimum scales = sum |2a+b|
minimum ADDs   = 2 sum b
minimum total = their sum, attained simultaneously

(1+i), (1+i)^-1: exactly 4 ADDs + 2 scales = 6
```

This answers Open next question 2 of Sagar Thakrar / thakrarsagar's #1566. Its standalone transition bounds, temporal-gauge setting and Hanson Sun / bbMisk's #1490 common-rounding lineage retain their credit. The new step is a joint lower bound using classical lattice-index distance and row support. No predecessor is audited or reverified. The proof, construction and verifier were produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence

- Before, #1566 excluded joint transitions from its theorem because opposite determinant valuations might cancel. The reciprocal pair has total determinant one. After, the lattice-index distance still forces two individual scales and row support forces four ADDs; explicit words attain both. The written argument covers every finite helper count, every integer exponent and any finite restored dirty workspace.
- The standalone verifier enumerates 1,011 attaining endpoints with literal rational matrices and inverse restoration, 42 finite lattice quotients, 216 lattice triangles, all 4,681 words through length four over the eight-gate small alphabet, and 14 rejecting controls. The generated receipt binds all other package files by SHA256. Finite checks corroborate the universal written proof.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized CPython 3.12.15 pass locally on macOS 27.0.1 arm64. Registered commands took 0.53 and 0.36 seconds locally, each below its 120-second timeout. The complete registered runner, indentation check and committed-byte/source-history preflight pass. Relocated read-only Git-free replay and receipt/source/CLI corruption controls pass. No assertion is required for acceptance.

From the worktree root, use these exact local reproduction commands:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/joint-gaussian-transition-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/joint-gaussian-transition-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/joint-gaussian-transition-floor
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/joint-gaussian-transition-floor --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace the absolute path. Standard library only. Expected markers are `PASS_JOINT_GAUSSIAN_TRANSITION_FLOOR`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Default replay writes nothing. `--emit-result` prints the generated receipt to stdout for external storage.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The alphabet counts signed unit ADDs, individual doublings and halvings. Coordinate permutations and negations are granted free. The required endpoint is the pure block-diagonal transition with identity on every dirty workspace coordinate. A separately required return has the same cost; a round trip with no intermediate requirement can be empty.

Fusing transitions with original operations, other coefficient families, singular clean workspace, COPY/clear, nonlinear gates and larger native primitives are outside scope. Routing, precision, ownership, complete scalar-word optimization, paid profiles, compiler/stock/outer admission and a complete multiplication theorem are not established. No Lean, Docker or selected cold replay was run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Open next questions

Can a transition fused with one actual signed SCALE or ADD beat the complete corresponding real-gauge invoice? Start with its literal dirty-input endpoint and an attaining word. A source-bound fused boundary and complete caller invoice remain missing. Further pure joint-transition searches cannot evade the proved charge in this alphabet.

## Related open work

- #5969 simplifies ordinary P104 ADDs after sign normalization. This proves an isolated Gaussian transition floor and does not compute or compare that word's scalar saving.
- #5999 shares a P104 linear form through a dirty destination. Its changed non-block-diagonal endpoint is outside this theorem; no cumulative saving or competing transition count is claimed.
- The live search found no open PR studying the same pure joint Gaussian transition endpoint. Merged #1732 optimizes temporal gauge choices with separately charged transitions; it does not lower their joint elementary implementation. Merged #5370 prices Gaussian unit phases on tapes, a different primitive and cost model.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package. Seven new files under `research/joint-gaussian-transition-floor/`; no shared code, predecessor package or selected-frontier file changes.
